title: Era Material Sample Sets for Mold Remediation Asbestos Sampling
content:
Pre-removal asbestos sampling on a Mold Remediation job takes an era-material sample set according to where the growth is and how old the building is.

**Standard.** The building age is the whole years from 1 January of the year built to the job's opened date, counted in whole calendar months and divided by twelve with any fraction dropped. Growth in a living area or basement of a building whose age is at least 75 years (the plaster-era age) adds the plaster set fee of 145.00 for plaster, skim coat and lath to the sampling line; growth in an attic or crawlspace adds the insulation set fee of 165.00 for loose-fill and vermiculite insulation; every other job adds no era-material charge.

## Conditions and results

| Growth location | Building age | Era-material charge |
|---|---|---|
| Living area or basement | 75 years or more | 145.00 plaster set |
| Living area or basement | Below 75 years | None |
| Attic or crawlspace | Any | 165.00 insulation set |
| HVAC | Any | None |

## Counting the building age

Whole calendar months are counted from 1 January of the year built to the opened date; the months are divided by twelve and the fraction is dropped. Hypothetical examples:

- Built 1950, opened 1 January 2025: 900 whole months, age 75, at the plaster-era age.
- Built 1950, opened 31 December 2024: 899 whole months, age 74, below it.
- Built 1946, opened 14 May 2024: 940 whole months, age 78.
